source_sql: SELECT patient_id, DATE_ADD(index_date, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS followup_date FROM hc_patients ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, index_date + INTERVAL '7 DAY' AS followup_date FROM hc_patients ORDER BY patient_id NULLS FIRST

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, DATEDIFF(end_date,start_date) AS days_on_treatment FROM hc_treatments ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, CAST(AGE(CAST(end_date AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(start_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS days_on_treatment FROM hc_treatments ORDER BY patient_id NULLS FIRST

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, IFNULL(result_value, -1) AS value_or_missing FROM hc_labs ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, COALESCE(result_value, -1) AS value_or_missing FROM hc_labs ORDER BY patient_id NULLS FIRST

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, CASE WHEN age_years >= 18 AND consent_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eligible FROM hc_patients ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, CASE WHEN age_years >= 18 AND consent_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eligible FROM hc_patients ORDER BY patient_id NULLS FIRST

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(result_value) AS nonnull_labs FROM hc_labs GROUP BY patient_id ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, COUNT(result_value) AS nonnull_labs FROM hc_labs GROUP BY patient_id ORDER BY patient_id NULLS FIRST

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, result_value FROM hc_labs ORDER BY result_value, patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, result_value FROM hc_labs ORDER BY result_value NULLS FIRST, patient_id NULLS FIRST

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, CASE WHEN result_value IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN result_value > 10 THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END AS status FROM hc_labs ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, CASE WHEN result_value IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN result_value > 10 THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END AS status FROM hc_labs ORDER BY patient_id NULLS FIRST

source_sql: SELECT patient_id, YEAR(index_date) AS visit_year, MONTH(index_date) AS visit_month FROM hc_patients ORDER BY patient_id
target_sql: SELECT patient_id, YEAR(CAST(index_date AS DATE)) AS visit_year, MONTH(CAST(index_date AS DATE)) AS visit_month FROM hc_patients ORDER BY patient_id NULLS FIRST
